properties.name: size
properties.description: This is 'Size' props. Please Select to 'medium' or 'small'.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Under the ur-checkbox-wrapper, create a ur-checkbox based on the information of that property. When used with slot, slot have priority.

properties.name: guideMessage
properties.description: The guide message that appears at the bottom. If there is no setting, no output. ur-checkbox-wrapper does not occupy space for message output. If you want to output a message, you need to make space.

properties.name: successMessage
properties.description: The message that is output if validate passes. If there is no setting, guide message or no message is printed. ur-checkbox-wrapper does not occupy space for message output. If you want to output a message, you need to make space.

properties.name: group
properties.description: ur-checkbox with ur-checkbox-wrapper set to the same ur-checkbox-wrapper among ur-checkbox-wrapper only affected. The wrapper and checkbox are both set to 'default' by default.

properties.name: messageStyle
properties.description: Announcement appearance attributes. You can specify the 'heavy' and 'light' attributes.

properties.name: rules
properties.description: Rule-set for using validator. Specified by an Array type, each element returns a boolean true on successful validation and a validate failure error message.

properties.name: lazy
properties.description: Components that use ur-validator-mixin call validateOnEvent() based on component properties. If lazy is set to true, validate() will not execute when validateOnEvent() is called.

properties.name: noShake
properties.description: Determines whether shake animation should be applied to the component when it fails.

events.name: click
events.description: If you click to component, this event will occur.
